altJa: 赤みのある桃色と淡いクリーム色が混じる、丸いモモ一個のイラスト。表面に細かな毛の表現があり、上部のくぼみから縦に溝が続いています。
observationJa: 丸みのある全体の輪郭、赤みと淡い色の混じり方、表面の細かな毛、縦の溝を見比べます。ここでは一つの果実の外観を観察します。
limitJa: モモの外観を学ぶための一例です。形や色、毛や溝の見え方は品種や状態によって異なり、この図だけで全てのモモを識別したり、品種・品質・熟度・病害・食用の可否を判定したりはしません。

provenance.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one original gentle botanical 2D illustration for an adult Japanese agriculture learning app. Depict exactly ONE whole common peach fruit, rounded and slightly heartlike with a shallow natural central suture/furrow running down its surface, soft pink-red blush blending into pale cream skin, subtle short velvety fuzz visible as delicate texture, small natural recessed stem end near the top. Entire fruit outline fully visible, generous margins, centered on a square plain warm ivory background. Soft hand-painted watercolor/gouache botanical style, restrained fine contour and gentle dimensional shading, not photorealism and not glossy plastic. No leaf needed; avoid decorative branches. No second fruit, no cut face, no exposed flesh, no stone, no bite, no leaves hiding the fruit, no ruler or scale, no labels, no writing, no letters, no logos or watermark. Show one common-appearance example only, not a specific cultivar and not a ripeness, quality, disease or edibility guide. Original independently composed artwork, no reference image supplied.
